name: proof-qa-automation
description: QA Automation Suite for Proof Platform - built with WebdriverIO & Playwright

scripts.test: TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=true NODE_OPTIONS='' npx wdio run src/config/wdio.conf.js
scripts.test:e2e: TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=true NODE_OPTIONS='' npx wdio run src/config/wdio.conf.js --suite e2e
scripts.test:smoke: TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=true NODE_OPTIONS='' npx wdio run src/config/wdio.conf.js --suite smoke
scripts.test:regression: TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true TS_NODE_SKIP_IGNORE=true NODE_OPTIONS='' npx wdio run src/config/wdio.conf.js --suite regression
scripts.report: npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && npx allure open allure-report
